title: The Firelight Lightbox WordPress plugin before 2.3.24 does not properly escape image attribute values before…
description: The Firelight Lightbox WordPress plugin versions before 2.3.24 improperly escape image attribute values, allowing users with contributor-level access or higher to inject arbitrary web scripts. These scripts execute when other users view or preview the affected content, leading to a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability.
